scope: Approved official technical documentation research only; no perfume/data/image acquisition, installs or dependency selection

records.title: typing — Support for type hints
records.findings: Annotations are not runtime validation. Protocol supports structural interface descriptions. Runtime-checkable protocol checks do not validate complete function signatures.
records.project_inference: Keep ports/domain typed independently of HTTP and validate untrusted input separately. A Protocol sketch would describe a future port, not create an authenticated transport.
records.limits: Installed Python observed3.11.9; no type checker installed/run; maintenance documentation version is not installed runtime version.

records.title: dataclasses — Data Classes
records.findings: Dataclasses generate methods from annotated fields. With limited exceptions the decorator does not inspect annotated field types. Frozen dataclasses emulate read-only instances.
records.project_inference: Reuse existing frozen typed domain records without treating construction or frozen=True as proof of strict validation, rights, deeply immutable referenced objects or authorization.
records.limits: No new dataclass or runtime validator implemented; source fields and generated methods must be distinguished.

records.title: fractions — Rational numbers
records.findings: Fraction supports exact rational arithmetic. Constructing from a binary float preserves that float value rather than the intended decimal ratio.
records.project_inference: Preserve accepted exact int/Fraction inputs and rational comparison. Order within compatible partitions before proposed wire integer-string serialization and display rounding.
records.limits: Python Fraction itself accepts formats the project forbids; a future transport must apply narrower explicit grammar and numeric bounds. No float coercion or limit_denominator repair.

records.title: Dependencies — FastAPI
records.document_version: UNVERSIONED / LIVING; no installed FastAPI version selected or verified
records.findings: Dependency injection supplies declared shared dependencies and can organize authentication, role checks and database connections.
records.project_inference: If later selected, compose session verification, a genuine principal lease and per-use authorization through explicit dependencies. Domain modules must not import framework dependencies.
records.limits: A dependency does not create PostgreSQL logins, verify all effective privileges, establish an immutable owner binding or prove RLS/pool isolation. Official page installer suggestions were not executed.

records.title: OAuth2 scopes — FastAPI
records.document_version: UNVERSIONED / LIVING; no installed FastAPI version selected or verified
records.findings: OAuth2 scopes are integrated with OpenAPI. The application still enforces scopes and other security requirements in its own code. OAuth2 scopes are optional.
records.project_inference: Keep provider/session choice unresolved; scopes alone cannot authorize a private object, source use, asset or genuine database principal. Verify ownership/scope before lookup/count/pagination/scoring/bytes.
records.limits: Research does not select OAuth2, JWT, an auth provider, the examples secret handling, or a browser password flow.

records.title: Strict Mode — Pydantic Validation
records.document_version: UNVERSIONED / LIVING latest; original https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/concepts/strict_mode/ redirected here; exact package version not shown
records.findings: Default validation can coerce input. Strict mode reduces coercion but JSON input can still accept representations such as date strings that strict Python validation rejects.
records.project_inference: If selected later, specify exact JSON grammar, forbid unknown keys/coercion and validate resource bounds plus domain semantics explicitly; a strict flag is insufficient. Never log rejected private values by default.
records.limits: No Pydantic version selected, installed or tested. JSON and Python validation paths need separate acceptance cases.

records.title: OpenAPI Specification latest
records.document_version: Observed v3.2.1, published10 September2026; latest alias is mutable
records.findings: OpenAPI describes HTTP interfaces. Multiple security requirement alternatives are OR; schemes within one requirement are AND. An empty requirement permits anonymous access.
records.project_inference: Use explicit operation security and bounded schemas only after HTTP/stack ADR. Review generated contracts for accidental optional security; keep logical IF IDs independent of HTTP paths.
records.limits: Latest published specification is not a selected runtime/framework contract version. No OpenAPI document or endpoints generated.

records.title: OpenAPI Specification v3.2.1
records.document_version: v3.2.1,10 September2026; explicit published version URL
records.findings: The versioned specification describes HTTP operations, schemas and security requirements. Security scheme documentation does not itself enforce application policy.
records.project_inference: A later explicit ADR must choose a supported published contract version and verify generator/client/server compatibility. This inventory remains framework-neutral.
records.limits: No compatibility test or adoption of3.2.1; package versions cannot be inferred from this page.

records.title: OpenAPI Specification v3.1.2
records.document_version: v3.1.2,19 September2025; explicit published version URL
records.findings: An independently versioned published3.1-series specification remains available, distinct from the observed latest3.2.1.
records.project_inference: Compare tooling support for versioned contracts after the stack ADR; do not equate an older supported contract with an implementation defect or silently upgrade.
records.limits: No version choice, runtime acceptance or generated contract implied; compatibility remains untested.

records.title: PostgreSQL row security
records.findings: Enabled RLS defaults to denial without policies. Superusers and BYPASSRLS roles bypass it; owners normally bypass it.
records.project_inference: Reject privileged application connections; inspect effective privileges and applicable policies.
records.limits: Not proof of repository policies or live-server behavior.

records.title: PostgreSQL session information
records.findings: session_user identifies the session; current_user identifies execution context. Privilege inquiry functions answer different membership and access questions.
records.project_inference: Preserve the existing session_user subject mapping and verify connection identity separately from browser authentication.
records.limits: Documentation reference version is not the unknown deployed version.

records.title: PostgreSQL SET ROLE
records.findings: SET ROLE changes current_user and privilege checking. It does not change the original authenticated login. Membership SET and INHERIT capabilities differ.
records.project_inference: Role switching cannot establish a browser user as the genuine database subject.
records.limits: No role command executed.

records.title: PostgreSQL SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION
records.findings: Changing session identity to another user requires an initially superuser-authenticated session. Reset restores the original identity.
records.project_inference: Reject superuser impersonation as the future application binding design.
records.limits: An identity equality check alone cannot prove an unprivileged connection origin.

records.title: PostgreSQL role attributes
records.findings: LOGIN permits an initial connection. Superuser privileges bypass permission checks. Role management and database creation are separate capabilities.
records.project_inference: Review genuine LOGIN, NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS and absence of administrative powers before a pilot.
records.limits: Role names or flags alone are insufficient privilege proof.

records.title: PostgreSQL role membership
records.findings: Membership can expose privileges through inheritance or permit role switching. Membership chains and options affect the resulting access.
records.project_inference: Test effective object/function privileges and indirect memberships; do not assume NOINHERIT alone removes all capabilities.
records.limits: Actual server-version compatibility remains unverified.

records.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
records.findings: Read Committed SELECT uses a statement snapshot; later statements can observe subsequently committed changes. A snapshot does not prevent concurrent revocation after checking.
records.project_inference: Use fresh authorization reads and final operation checks; specify cancellation and race behavior.
records.limits: No strict instantaneous revocation guarantee follows from a transaction.

records.title: OWASP API1 object authorization
records.findings: Object identifiers must be checked against the caller and requested action. Identifier complexity does not replace authorization.
records.project_inference: Authorize objects and fields before restricted counts, pagination, scoring or byte access.
records.limits: Guidance does not certify any proposed handler.

records.title: OWASP authorization
records.findings: Recommend least privilege, default denial, request-level permission checks, safe failures, appropriate logging and authorization tests.
records.project_inference: Centralize gate contracts while preserving service and database enforcement.
records.limits: Exact framework integration and test evidence remain future work.

records.title: OWASP session management
records.findings: Session management connects authentication with access control. Session identifiers require protection, renewal and expiration or invalidation controls.
records.project_inference: Specify server-side validation, logout, privilege changes and pool cleanup in a later exact contract.
records.limits: No cookie, token, provider, TLS or session implementation selected.

records.title: HTTP caching
records.findings: no-store restricts intentional cache storage and requests prompt volatile cleanup; it is not sufficient privacy protection. private differs from no-store.
records.project_inference: Propose no-store for operational data and explicit in-memory cleanup; never promise remote browser erasure.
records.limits: No headers or storage behavior implemented or tested.

records.title: Docker volumes
records.findings: Volumes persist beyond container lifecycles and can be mounted by containers. Container removal does not by itself erase volume data.
records.project_inference: Separate private asset storage, access controls, retention and restore checks from container packaging.
records.limits: Named volumes do not provide application authorization; Docker availability not revalidated.

records.title: Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0
records.findings: License freedoms remain while conditions are met. Attribution and ShareAlike conditions apply; other rights may still matter. The deed is a summary.
records.project_inference: Keep project authorization denial separate from license revocation; verify exact asset binding and permission conditions.
records.limits: No candidate rights grant or legal clearance established by this research.

records.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: Normative accessibility criteria cover keyboard operation, text alternatives, focus, errors and status semantics; they are technology independent.
project_inference: Propose WCAG 2.2 AA acceptance for future pages; document concrete keyboard, screen-reader and responsive checks.
limits: This research is not a conformance audit; the future UI does not exist.

records.title: Read Me First — ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
records.document_version: LIVING; APG guidance for ARIA 1.2, no immutable page release observed
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: ARIA roles do not supply native keyboard behavior. Examples require browser and assistive-technology interoperability testing.
project_inference: Prefer native HTML controls and labels; explicitly test custom tabs, comboboxes and chip controls.
limits: Informative widget guidance does not prove cross-browser support or WCAG conformance.

records.title: Tabs Pattern — APG
records.document_version: LIVING; no immutable page release observed
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: The pattern defines tab/panel relationships, selected state and arrow-key navigation; automatic activation assumes panels appear without noticeable latency.
project_inference: Use manual activation for remote protected panels; focus movement must not demand private prefetch.
limits: A widget pattern is not application authorization or an implemented control.

records.title: Combobox Pattern — APG
records.document_version: LIVING; no immutable page release observed
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: The pattern specifies labeled input/popup semantics, option navigation, Enter selection, Escape dismissal and standard text-editing behavior.
project_inference: Reference and vocabulary pickers must preserve editing/focus while selecting explicit authorized identities.
limits: Authorization, exact domain validation and suggestion-query bounds remain project requirements.

records.title: Understanding SC 4.1.3: Status Messages
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: Status messages can be programmatically exposed without focus; concise search completion/count messages differ from the entire result list.
project_inference: Announce loading/completion summaries without moving focus or repeatedly reading result cards.
limits: Live announcements must themselves avoid unauthorized counts or private hidden details.

records.title: Understanding SC 2.4.7: Focus Visible
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: Keyboard-operable interfaces need a visible focus indicator; it must remain visible while keyboard focus is shown.
project_inference: Retain visible focus across local results, dialogs and tab/combobox interaction.
limits: Actual styling, contrast and browser behavior need later testing.

records.title: Understanding SC 2.4.11: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: Author-created content must not entirely hide a component when it receives keyboard focus.
project_inference: Test sticky navigation, notices and dialogs against focus visibility on narrow layouts.
limits: AA minimum partial visibility differs from the stronger AAA enhanced criterion.

records.title: Understanding SC 3.3.1: Error Identification
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: Detected input errors identify the affected item and describe the error in text; no single error-layout arrangement is mandated.
project_inference: Use linked error summary and field descriptions after explicit failed submit; preserve safe inputs.
limits: Summary focus behavior is a project choice; native validation and security still need independent tests.

records.title: Server and Client Components — Next.js App Router
records.document_version: LIVING; observed documentation selector Latest v16.4.6; installed project version NOT VERIFIED
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: App Router defaults pages/layouts to Server Components. Interactive handlers use Client Components; payloads include client props and navigation can prefetch/cache.
project_inference: If selected later, keep interactive drafts separate from authorized server projections; review serialized props, streaming, prefetch and caches.
limits: Reading documentation selects no framework or version and proves no private-cache behavior.

records.title: How to implement authentication — Next.js
records.document_version: LIVING; observed documentation selector Latest v16.4.6; installed project version NOT VERIFIED
records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
findings: The guide separates authentication, sessions and authorization; recommends authorization near data in a DAL and limited DTOs, beyond optimistic route checks.
project_inference: A hidden route or UI component is insufficient; enforce session/object/field rights at service/data access and preserve genuine PostgreSQL identity.
limits: Guide examples do not solve this repository's nonadmin session binding, RLS, pool reuse or revocation contracts.

records.retrieval_time_basis: Completed research-batch recording checkpoint after all page opens; not a server publication timestamp or per-page request timestamp.
